snippet.title: Bento Blocks Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Bento Blocks is a puzzle game about slicing and arranging ingredients into quirky lunch boxes. 

Test your culinary creativity across 180+ hand-crafted levels, each with its own twist and satisfying solution. 

Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3311670/Bento_Blocks/
